Intermediate.learningGoal: Implement a minimal ECS: entities, component tables and systems querying them.
gotchas: Deleting entities while iterating invalidates iteration
Entity ids should not be reused without a generation or handled explicitly
Component presence checks need nil, not truthiness, if false is a valid value
goodSolutionShows: Components stored per type keyed by entity id
Query function for entities having several components
Systems as plain functions taking world and dt
shapeHints: a movement system updating position from velocity with dt
a health system removing dead entities safely
querying entities with position and sprite

Advanced.learningGoal: Add deferred entity destruction, component events and system ordering.
gotchas: Destruction deferred to the end of the update
System order changes results; make it explicit
Components added during iteration may or may not be visited; define it
goodSolutionShows: Command buffer for create/destroy applied after systems
Deterministic iteration order via sorted ids
shapeHints: a damage system and a death system with ordered execution
a world with add/remove component events

Expert.learningGoal: Optimise and generalise an ECS: archetype-style grouping, sparse sets and cache-friendly iteration in LuaJIT.
gotchas: Removing from an array by swapping with the last element changes order and indices
Hash-part tables are slower to iterate than arrays
Index maps must be updated on swap-remove
goodSolutionShows: Sparse set with dense arrays and swap-remove
Tests proving contents after many adds and removes
shapeHints: benchmark-free test that proves dense iteration yields all live entities
